Castlevania - Vampire's Kiss.name: Castlevania: Dracula X
Castlevania - Vampire's Kiss.summary: The Legend Returns... Rising up from his eternal sleep, Count Dracula is back again to battle the descendants of the great vampire-stalking Belmont family of the Castlevania series. He has summoned his dark minions-Cerberus, Minaurus, and the Salamander-to bring a reign of terror on the land. Grab your whip and try to defeat these dark forces in this new conversion of the hit Japanese game: DRACULA X. The 7+ stages unfold with myriad possibilities depending on the choices you make during the game. This multi-ending, multi-story feature takes you through many levels of adventure. You must strategically use magical tomes, mystical power-ups and titanic weapons to defeat the horrifying bosses and discover secret bonus levels.

F1 World Championship Edition.name: F1: World Championship Edition
F1 World Championship Edition.summary: F1: World Championship Edition is the sequel to F1 (released as Formula One in the USA).

Phalanx - The Enforce Fighter A-144.name: Phalanx
Phalanx - The Enforce Fighter A-144.summary:
A futuristic shooter, Phalanx is the name of the prototype starfighter flown by Wink Baufield, a genetically enhanced pilot. It is sent to protect and reclaim Delia IV, a planet in the Andromeda galaxy, which has been colonized by humans for interstellar research purposes. However, an unknown and powerful alien force has overtaken the planet, the military defenses have been completely overwhelmed, and all hope rests on the Phalanx.

You fly through eight levels, first through various locations in Delia IV, and then you invade the aliens themselves. Like most shooters, you can upgrade your weapons by picking up bonus items dropped by enemy craft.

Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Rev.name: Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge
Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Rev.summary:
Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge is a side-scrolling action game featuring Spider-Man and members of the X-Men. The story centers on Arcade, who has built a large amusement park filled with traps to capture and kill the superheroes. The game begins with Spider-Man witnessing the X-Men being kidnapped and following them into Arcade's park.

After entering the park, the player can control Spider-Man, Cyclops, Storm, Gambit, or Wolverine, each of whom is trapped in a different section of Arcade's maze. Each character has distinct abilities used to navigate hazards, defeat enemies, and confront bosses, with the overall objective of guiding all five heroes safely out of the park.
